goals.description: Read the project structure and migration-relevant files, identify configuration, mapper XML/raw SQL, Java mapper/entity packages, migration scripts, and validation tooling, then publish a preload plan for later goals.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: This goal is read-only with respect to /workspace. Inspect the repository to identify Spring/MyBatis configuration files, mapper XML files, raw SQL or migration directories, Java dal/mysql mapper/entity files, @KeySequence usages, and existing validation commands. Do not modify workspace files. Before ending, call set_preload_plan exactly once with JSON of shape {"goals":{"G001":["relative/path"],"G002":["relative/path"],...}} for all later goals G001-G006. Use the complete goal graph to predict each goal's entry filesystem state after all transitive predecessors are merged. Include concise, useful text files each goal would otherwise need to read: config files for config work, mapper XML/raw SQL for SQL conversion, Java/XML/config files for package refactor, Java entity files plus migration SQL locations for sequence work, and implementation/test/config/reference files for validation. Omit dependency directories, caches, build outputs, generated bundles, and control files.
goals.name: Explore workspace and plan goal context

goals.description: Prepare concrete acceptance criteria and exact validation commands for the MySQL-to-PostgreSQL migration based on the inspected project and the skill checklist.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on validation preparation. Using the context from G000 and preloaded files, derive a concise checklist and exact commands for final verification: config checks, SQL dialect grep/search checks, package/namespace consistency checks, sequence checks, and the project's available tests/build commands. Do not redesign implementation and do not depend on completed edits. Avoid writing workspace files unless an isolated validation helper is clearly necessary; if you create one, place it where it will not conflict with implementation work and record its path. End with a predecessor summary that G006 can reuse, including acceptance criteria and exact commands.
goals.name: Derive migration validation plan

goals.description: Modify application configuration for PostgreSQL JDBC, validation query, default schema usage, and MyBatis-Plus BIT-compatible logical delete values.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Edit only project configuration files for the database migration. Change JDBC URLs from MySQL to PostgreSQL form, preserving host/database settings where possible and adding currentSchema when the target schema is known or can be represented by the existing project convention. Replace validation-query values such as SELECT 1 FROM DUAL with SELECT 1. Update MyBatis-Plus logical delete values from numeric 1/0 to PostgreSQL BIT literals "B'1'" and "B'0'" when the project uses BIT logical deletion. Do not perform mapper XML SQL rewrites or Java package refactors in this goal.
goals.name: Update PostgreSQL datasource and MyBatis-Plus config

goals.description: Convert MyBatis XML and other raw SQL from MySQL dialect to PostgreSQL syntax, including functions, date operations, upsert forms, UPDATE JOIN, BIT literal comparisons, and GROUP BY strictness.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on mapper XML and raw SQL files. Convert MySQL-specific SQL to PostgreSQL equivalents: IFNULL to COALESCE, DATE_FORMAT to TO_CHAR with appropriate format adjustments, DATE_ADD interval expressions, CURDATE to CURRENT_DATE, DATETIME casts to TIMESTAMP, DATE(x) to CAST(x AS DATE), INSERT IGNORE and ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE to ON CONFLICT forms where enough key information exists, and UPDATE ... JOIN to UPDATE ... FROM. Replace hand-written deleted = 0/1 comparisons with deleted = B'0'/B'1' for BIT columns. Review GROUP BY queries so non-aggregate selected columns are grouped or wrapped in suitable aggregates. Do not change Java package names or application-level datasource settings in this goal.
goals.name: Convert mapper SQL dialect and query semantics

goals.description: Rename MyBatis-related packages and namespaces from dal.mysql to dal.pg, updating Java paths/imports, XML namespaces, and related logging/package configuration consistently.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Perform the optional but recommended package/namespace refactor if the project uses dal.mysql naming. Move src/main/java package directories from dal/mysql to dal/pg where appropriate, update Java package declarations and imports, update MyBatis XML namespace references from dal.mysql.* to dal.pg.*, and adjust related application logging or mapper package configuration. Because this goal may touch files already edited for config and SQL conversion, preserve all predecessor changes.
goals.name: Refactor MyBatis package and namespace to dal.pg

goals.description: Ensure MyBatis-Plus @KeySequence usage and PostgreSQL sequence DDL are present and aligned for auto-incremented entities.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the post-refactor Java entity/DO classes and migration SQL layout. For entities that require MyBatis-Plus sequence-based IDs, ensure @KeySequence names are correct and package imports remain valid. Add or update PostgreSQL migration SQL for each required sequence in the correct schema, using START WITH values that are clearly placeholders or computed from available project migration data; include comments or safe follow-up notes when live max(id) values must be checked after data migration. Do not revisit generic SQL dialect conversion except where needed for sequence DDL consistency.
goals.name: Add PostgreSQL sequence support

goals.description: Run the prepared validation checks and project tests, inspect failures for the migration checklist, and make focused repairs needed to complete the PostgreSQL migration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Reuse the validation plan, acceptance criteria, and exact commands produced by G001. Adapt only when actual workspace state or command results require it; do not redesign validation from scratch. Run static searches and available build/test commands to catch remaining MySQL dialect usage, BIT integer comparisons, stale dal.mysql references, missing sequence definitions, invalid validation queries, and GROUP BY issues. Make only focused final repairs needed to satisfy the checklist, preserving predecessor edits. End with a summary of commands run, results, remaining risks, and any live database checks still required such as confirming sequence START WITH values exceed current max IDs.
goals.name: Execute validation and final fixes
